text_block_list.text: Narita Brian and I are visiting a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, do we really need to ask the gods for help at this point?
I've been worried about Narita Brian's condition recently, so I tell her that I'd like to pray for her health.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …You know, it's my responsibility to take care of myself. Not the gods' or Buddha's.
choice_data_list: I just want to do whatever I can.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Sigh. Fine, if you're going to insist.
I pray for Narita Brian's speedy recovery.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Okay, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I didn't pray for anything.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I just went along with it to make you feel better.
choice_data_list: Sorry to make you do that…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No matter. It's just a difference in customs. But, I will say this…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You're the only one in charge of your own body. Victory is something you've got to take for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's not the gods that are going to answer your prayers…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph. If you got it, then let's go.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Although… I have to admit, there is a nice breeze here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm feeling pretty good. How about a quick run before going back?
Perhaps it's just the nice change of pace, but Narita Brian seems to have a spring in her step.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh… The wind smells damp…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I don't like it…
Rumble, rumble… Drip drop…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Agh! It's raining!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch! Let's hurry back!
Perhaps we displeased the gods?
Drenched by the rain, Narita Brian doesn't say another word the whole way back.
